constraint_prompts.purpose: the poem's own lines are verified and timed to this reel
constraint_prompts.prompt: Pulsing, and head throbbing from the music — and empty, on a crowded floor of sweated perfumes and temptations. The soul escapes my body, and leaves him on the dance floor — just flesh and bones. Rejection and heartache hit different, with no feelings afloat. I want my soul to imagine my body. Watch strangers collide and spark electric currents that gamut the mood. We want him to be the last to leave. Now let us put my soul in the middle of an open field — at the equator of a planet much larger than my own, and much hotter. Cool me down: pouring unfiltered water out of ice baths, salted from the closest moons, from angles of the newest religions — their graces curse or bless me. Only infinity will tell. Now bring my soul back to my body: to lean back, breathe in the smoke that fills the room — how good it is to finally get acquainted with the night. Unfamiliar, yet relatable mountains in the distance; wandering thoughts within reach. Accepting you

failure_risks: disocclusion holes where back-paint is thin
